references.text: Moses gave the command to the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh that they should go armed ahead of their brothers across the Jordan before they could settle on the east side
The agreement between Moses and the eastern tribes that they would help the rest of Israel conquer the land west of the Jordan
Moses reminds the two and a half tribes of their obligation to cross the Jordan armed ahead of their brothers
Joshua reminds Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh of what Moses had commanded them regarding crossing the Jordan
Joshua sends the two and a half tribes back to their inheritance after they have fulfilled their obligation to help their brothers
